description: This file contains Python classes and functions for handling layout test results, including parsing JSON data, representing individual test results, and iterating over test results.

classes.name: LayoutTestResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a single layout test, providing methods to access test status and result details.

classes.name: LayoutTestResults
classes.description: Handles collections of layout test results, including parsing from JSON strings, filtering, and iteration.

methods.name: results_from_string
methods.description: Creates a LayoutTestResults object from a JSON string containing test results.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes LayoutTestResults with parsed JSON data and optional revision info.

methods.name: run_was_interrupted
methods.description: Checks if the test run was interrupted.

methods.name: builder_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the builder that ran the tests.

methods.name: chromium_revision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the Chromium build associated with the test results.

methods.name: result_for_test
methods.description: Retrieves the result object for a specific test identified by its path.

methods.name: for_each_test
methods.description: Iterates over all test results, applying a handler function.

methods.name: _for_each_test
methods.description: Static method to recursively traverse test result tree and apply handler.

methods.name: _test_result_tree
methods.description: Returns the nested dictionary of test results.

methods.name: _filter_tests
methods.description: Filters tests based on a provided result filter function.

methods.name: didnt_run_as_expected_results
methods.description: Returns tests that did not run as expected.
